commit.message:
test(#2047): the test-only get_pending_input mirrors production

From #2033's review: with no active turn the #[cfg(test)]
get_pending_input drained mailbox mail, which production
(get_pending_input_for_running_task) no longer does. It now delegates to
the production path, and the test-only allow_untracked_mailbox branch is
removed (production never took it, so its behavior is unchanged). The
four session/tests.rs checks that polled an empty slot to inspect queued
mail now use drain_mailbox_input_items(); a new test pins the helper to
production. Drops the leftover '(rev-2033)' header tag.
